name: AWS Douglas County data center campuses
summary: Amazon Web Services plan announced in January 2025 to invest at least $5 billion in data center campuses in Douglas County, west of Atlanta, with more than 250 full-time jobs. The county called it the largest capital investment in its history and approved a 15-year property tax break. It is part of a wider AWS plan of at least $11 billion across Douglas and Butts counties, which Amazon has not split by county. Amazon declined to disclose exact sites, citing security, and said construction would take several years.

location.note: Amazon did not disclose the sites; coordinates are the Douglas County point from its Wikipedia article (Nominatim was unavailable).

parties.name: Douglas County Board of Commissioners
parties.note: Co-issued the announcement and approved a 15-year property tax break; the county is also funding water infrastructure improvements.

metrics.note: Douglas County figure covering all AWS campuses planned in the county. Amazon's Georgia announcement gives at least $11 billion for Douglas and Butts counties combined without a breakdown.

notes: The AJC reported at announcement that it was unclear whether Georgia Power or an electric membership cooperative would serve the sites. No opened source reports construction progress or a power capacity for the Douglas County campuses.
